sloka: स जातमन्युः प्रसमीक्ष्य विक्रमं स्थिरं स्थितः संयति दुर्निवारणम् ।समाहितात्मा हनुमन्तमाहवे प्रचोदयामास शरैस्त्रिभिः शितैः ।। ५.४७.१०।।।।
transliteration: sa jātamanyuḥ prasamīkṣya vikramaṁ sthiraṁ sthitaḥ saṁyati durnivāraṇam ।samāhitātmā hanumantamāhave pracodayāmāsa śaraistribhiḥ śitaiḥ ।। 5.47.10।।।।

translations.english: Knowing that it is difficult to win Hanuman who was steady and of irresistible valour Aksha was angry. Remaining steady, with full attention, he provoked the vanara to fight and released three sharp arrows.
